# CHIVALROUS by Sarkar

> Chivalrous is a unisex woody-spicy parfum (25% oil concentration) by Sarkar, a premium fragrance house founded by Bhuvan Bam. Available in 50 ml (₹999), 100 ml (₹2,000) and 200 ml (₹2,499), with free shipping within 24-36 hours.

Notes: top - bergamot, black pepper, saffron; heart - cedarwood, iris, leather; base - oud, amber, patchouli. Made for workdays, evenings and everyday wear. Tagline: "Power without the noise."

## Pages

- [Chivalrous](https://chivalrous-scent-unveiled.lovable.app/): Product page with notes, story, prices and FAQs.
- [Know Sarkar](https://chivalrous-scent-unveiled.lovable.app/about): About the Sarkar fragrance house and its founder.
